difficulty.notes: Hallandsleden says the section is easy overall, mostly flat, and follows streets/cycleways plus the old railway embankment. The Swedish text notes the short Flähult passage, where hikers leave and regain the embankment, is more blue than green. Naturkartan says red/krävande and route apps say moderate or hard, likely because of distance rather than technical terrain.

routeType.notes: Official order lists this as N8 after N7, but it is not a contiguous continuation from Ästad. It is best modeled as a western Varberg access branch/spur into the Åkulla junction, connecting near N6, N7 and M1 at Åkulla.

generalTrailRules: Short-period camping is generally possible under allemansrätten, but not on grazing land, agricultural land, plantations, near residences, or where it disturbs or damages.
Overnight stays are often prohibited in nature reserves; check the specific reserve.
Shelters cannot be reserved; bring a tent in peak season.
Dogs should be kept on lead; 1 March-20 August requires leash/strict supervision in nature, and special care is needed in pastures.
Hunting may occur August-January, with the most intense period in the first weeks of elk hunting around early October.

routeSafetyNotes.notes: Official page says the section leaves Varberg through streets/cycleways, crosses the E6, then enters open farmland. Treat as mixed urban/cycleway/road-adjacent walking rather than remote forest at the start.

Official Swedish page says most of the section follows the old Varberg-Ätran railway embankment, but at Flähult hikers must go down to the road and back up to the embankment; that short passage is more blue than green.
The 2020 full-stage field report and route character both support long exposed stretches across roads/open farmland; useful hot-weather caveat.
Hunnestad former station house is now a private residence; official page asks visitors to respect this.
Direct N8 reports did not identify wet problem sections, but adjacent Åkulla/Bockstens trails can be wet or muddy after rain. Do not overstate this for the main line.

findings: Used bus from Varberg to Åkulla and started at Åkulla friluftsgård.
Describes the stage as dominated by long straight stretches on country roads and gravel roads.
In hot sunny weather, several kilometers had little or no shade.
Completed to Varberg central station in about 4 hours with few/no real stops.
Photos/labels corroborate open landscape, Grimeton radio station visibility, wayfinding, and Varberg end.

sourceContradictions.topic: Canonical route geometry and Varberg start
sourceContradictions.details: Official GPX/API geo_json is a 225-point 21.070 km LineString starting at 57.110104,12.249553. Official API line.geometry starts 322.4 m west at 57.109547,12.244312 and computes 21.913 km. OSM starts about 360 m west and computes about 22.050 km. Naturkartan reportedly starts at the GPX start but ends at the shared Åkulla junction.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official GPX/API geo_json as canonical. Keep API line.geometry/OSM western start as alternate harbor/access-line evidence only.

sourceContradictions.details: Official N8 GPX ends about 60-65 m from the shared Åkulla junction used by N6/N7/M1. Naturkartan reportedly ends within about 1 m of the shared junction.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Later import must decide whether to preserve exact official GPX endpoint or add a short connector/snap to the shared Åkulla junction.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page/API says 22 km; official GPX description says 21.1 km and computes 21.070 km; Naturkartan says 21.0 km; OSM relation sums about 22.050 km; AllTrails says 21.9 km; Pacer says 13.7 mi; Outdooractive says 22.3 km; En Vandringssaga says 21 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep official display distance 22 km and computed geometry QA distance 21.070 km. Treat other values as metadata differences.

sourceContradictions.details: Hallandsleden says green/easy; Naturkartan says red/krävande; AllTrails/Outdooractive say moderate; Pacer says hard.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official green/easy, with note that distance and the short Flähult passage may make it feel harder than the official technical grade.

sourceContradictions.details: Official Hallandsleden includes Varberg - Åkulla as N8 in Norra delleden/E1. Vandra.se calls the Varberg-Åkulla day an anslutningsled to Hallandsleden, and topology shows it is a western branch into the Åkulla junction rather than a continuation from N7.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Model as official Hallandsleden section N8 but preserve branch/spur topology and do not stitch after N7 as a through continuation.

sourceContradictions.details: Åkturen is seasonal and 2026 bus bay details conflict between current text and timetable/PDF row. Haksered/Brännhult fallback distances are described differently by destination pages, official N8 text and coordinate-derived distances.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Varberg station and Åkulla stop as primary commute points with seasonal caveats; model Haksered/Brännhult as fallback only and verify exact schedules close to use.

sourceContradictions.details: Places API includes a dense Varberg service cluster and side-trip POIs well away from the GPX line.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not bulk-import all Varberg restaurants/lodging or >1 km side-trip POIs as trail facilities. Use access/service metadata and import decisions per facility.

receivedReports.summary: Confirmed official name Varberg - Åkulla, N8/Norra delleden, Varberg municipality/Halland, official 22 km and green/easy grade; captured official description, Varberg/Åkulla access, endpoint cluster and official facilities/POIs. Flagged distance/difficulty conflicts, GPX/API line start conflict, endpoint cluster, dense Varberg place over-inclusion and no N8-specific closure.

Confirmed official GPX and API geo_json are identical 225-point 21.070 km lines from Varberg station area to Åkulla. API line.geometry is a 175-point 21.913 km conflicting line with a western Varberg start. Naturkartan mostly matches GPX but ends at the shared Åkulla junction; OSM relation 4174694 is secondary and locally divergent. Recommended official GPX/API geo_json as canonical planning-grade geometry.

Found no confirmed mid-stage shelter/campsite or potable water; facilities concentrate at Åkulla/Yasjön and Varberg start. Identified import-ready/pending facility records including Lägerplats Åkulla, Åkulla Outdoor Resort water/service cluster, Yasjön seasonal shelter, Obbhultsgård, Villa Stenhuset, Slumme sten, Broåsen, Hunnestad station house, Varberg start toilets/services, Grimeton and Bockstens side-trip records.

Confirmed start commute point Varberg station, ResRobot extId 740000110, about 0.11 km from GPX start. Confirmed endpoint stop Åkulla, extId 740074382, about 0.28 km from GPX end, useful mainly in Åkturen season. Documented 2026 Åkturen dates/times, Haksered/Brännhult line 651 fallbacks, Varberg parking constraints and Åkulla parking/service context.

Found medium field evidence. Best full-stage report is 2020 reverse Åkulla-Varberg, describing long straight road/gravel/rail-embankment walking, exposure and few stops. Recent 2025 AllTrails reviews report great conditions but little detail. Commercial/route-app sources support mostly easy but long walking, possible sparse marking and subjective low-scenery assessments.

No N8-specific closure/reroute found.
